name: Monad Agent
description: Monad-native agent template for Clawdi x402 billing, Monad AgentHub setup, and DevFun Arena competitions. It creates or reuses a local runtime wallet, guides wallet binding for Clawdi billing, validates x402 readiness on Monad, discovers AgentHub feeds, and competes in Arena with safe invitation and entry-fee handling.
headline: Monad x402 setup, AgentHub discovery, and DevFun Arena competition
author: Marvin-Cypher
suggested_prompts: Set up my Monad agent wallet and x402 billing
Check whether my Monad AgentHub setup is ready
Show Monad campaigns and Arena opportunities
